commit.message: test(mike): prove set-agnostic required-check consumption across automerge and Mike entry paths

intent: WP-0F2 buildable remainder (TIT-007, Mike-owned surfaces; plan docs/plans/TITANIUM_GRADE_REPOSITORY_HARDENING_2026-07-10.md:1092-1106): set-agnostic consumer proof that every CI-truth-contract required entry blocks Mike's gate on MISSING, PENDING, FAILURE, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, and ACTION_REQUIRED; that automerge.yml derives its required set solely from ci_parity_manifest.json with no private context list; that the manifest-driven automerge skip and the contract-driven Mike FAIL agree on every fail-closed state (same gate verdict, plan :1106); that workflow_dispatch, event, and schedule paths share the single evaluate job; and that bot-pr cannot bypass the required-check block. Tests bind to whatever the live contract declares, so final-set ratification (operator-gated, WP-0F1/Titanium) is exercised by these same tests without edits. Test-only; no runtime, contract, manifest, or workflow change.

honest_blockers: WP-0F2 full closure stays operator-gated on two decisions outside this packet: ratifying the FINAL required-check set (WP-0F1, Titanium-owned manifest/contract surfaces) and provisioning CI_PARITY_ADMIN_READ_TOKEN for continuously-authenticated live parity (ci-parity.yml:42,52). This packet closes the consumer-proof and same-verdict legs on Mike-owned surfaces only.

Tests are deliberately set-agnostic (they enumerate the live contract's required entries at runtime), so the ratified final set is exercised by these exact tests the moment WP-0F1 lands it — no re-edit, closing the plan's re-exercise requirement by construction.
forbidden_files is intentionally empty: no live sibling surface matches this packet's touched paths, the exact relaxation shipped in #1052/#1053 (first end-to-end consumer).
interface_mismatches: INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md carries no entry for the Mike merge-gate surface.
session_entry.rollback: Revert tests/test_pr_merge_control.py and this packet together; no runtime behavior changes to roll back.
